waits.title: Long waits: still needed?
waits.intro: Patients who have waited a long time and have not been asked recently whether they still need the appointment. Asking records that you asked. Nobody is removed from any list.
waits.caption: Long waiters, longest first
tol.title: Tolerances: red, amber, green
tol.intro: How far each measure may drift from its target. Green is within the tolerance. Amber is past it but within the limit. Red is past the limit and needs someone to act. A measure with no data is never shown as green. For percentages, the tolerance and limit are in percentage points.
tol.caption: Time, money and resources against their tolerances
tol.metric.lead_time_median_days: Median days from booking to visit
tol.by.intro: Each service and ward is judged by its own tolerance when one has been set, and by the whole service's tolerance otherwise.
tol.alerts.title: Alerts
tol.alerts.intro: A measure that goes past its red limit opens an alert. It closes by itself when the measure is no longer red. Acknowledging an alert says someone is looking at it; it does not close it.
tol.alerts.error: The alert could not be acknowledged.
